description: Use on your draft enhanced prompt before presenting it (optional). Returns a deterministic, heuristic report: for each scored area (Clear goal, Context, Constraints, Output format, Edge cases) whether the draft explicitly mentions it, with short evidence, plus lint findings such as capitalized pressure words, requests to expose reasoning, prefill instructions, leftover template variables and open [[placeholders]]. The checks match English keywords and headings: in a draft that looks mostly non-English, an area without a match is reported as unknown rather than not found. Detected as non-English: non-Latin scripts; German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Swedish, Turkish, Indonesian, Tagalog, Swahili and Romanized Hindi; and languages with many accented letters. Other languages, and short or terse drafts in any script, may be reported as not found. It gives no score; score with the brief's anchors. Pass target (for example "Midjourney") so image and video conventions apply.

prompt.description: The draft enhanced prompt (the full prompt, not the whole reply).

target.description: Where the prompt will run, for example "Claude Code", "ChatGPT" or "Midjourney". Leave out to infer it.

name: check_prompt

status.description: found: explicitly mentioned (keyword or heading match), not a judgement of quality. unknown: no match in a draft that looks mostly non-English.

mostlyEnglish.description: Whether the draft looks mostly English. The area checks match English keywords only.

title: Check a draft prompt
